ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity white pixels localized on lateral lobes against 55% low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central peduncle attachment and perimeter margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, high-contrast white contiguous regions on the lateral lobes bifurcated by a solid black central 'V' region. Intricate black linear vertical mottling and circular occlusions are spatially distributed across the white pixel patches.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge boundary; characterized by sharp micro-peaks and valleys with varying pixel amplitudes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex-upward curvature along the trailing edge, tapering to acute, slightly recurved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple high-contrast circular pixel clusters; notably two adjacent circular marks on the mid-left lobe and several isolated circular patterns on the upper-right lobe white field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous vertical black linear pixel disruptions traversing the white pigment on the left lobe; distinct white diagonal linear disruption located on the right lobe near the central black boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of high-intensity, textured white calcified deposits (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique concentric circular pigmentation pattern located on the inner margin of the right fluke lobe white patch.
